registryCustodian: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Bangladesh, with the official Settlement map service and Lalmonirhat district land administration route.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bengali first-party discovery queries were performed. Official DLRS, Settlement map search, DLRS map-purchase, Lalmonirhat district and Sadar routes were found.
requestOutcomes: The current Settlement JavaScript and DLRS map-purchase JavaScript/configuration were inspected. Anonymous division, district, survey, administrative-boundary, upazila and mouza discovery requests were executed. Lalmonirhat district boundary GeoJSON and public mouza records were returned, but no parcel polygon plus stable native parcel identity was returned. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request or TLS exception was used.

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite parcel key was evidenced; mouza/JL/survey values describe public map discovery rather than a verified parcel.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable public parcel identifier only if verified
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [25.9141742321487, 89.4409107961104] was preserved and not moved.
The administrative boundary response and mouza list do not establish parcel-vector coverage or citywide completeness.
The empty upazila response and HTTP 400 search responses are service/request limitations, not evidence of citywide absence.
No raw source-specific attribute set or retained sample GeoJSON is included.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account or registration fields were requested or retained.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: A public national cadastral/map service and Lalmonirhat administrative discovery were evidenced, but no anonymous parcel geometry or parcel-native identity was returned in this attempt.

uncertainty: The service may expose downloadable or viewer-specific survey sheets through a further workflow, but the bounded anonymous routes used here did not return parcel polygons. Coverage, update cadence, parcel identity semantics, CRS and citywide completeness remain unverified.
